pages.text: Welcome to Wandscape. Turning it into a magic town starts here.$(br2)Wandscape is a management sim mod: you place buildings, and $(bold)wizard NPCs do the work for you$() (building, gathering, crafting, guarding), while $(bold)tourists walk along the roads to spend in town$(). Your job is to decide where the town goes. This book can be opened at any time with the $(bold)H$() key.$(br2)$(italic)$(#6b5a45)Playing for the first time? Read $(l:wandscape:getting_started_guide)Getting Started: From Empty Land to a Tourist Town$(/l)$(italic)$(#6b5a45) first — it walks through the full game loop.$()
